answer: In an agent marketplace trading mesa weather data and karst surveys, every seller identity must lock $100 for 30 days before bidding; a whisper of reputation earns no exemption. A contract confiscates that bond if anyone presents two incompatible, signed final answers from that seller for the same job. Creating 1,000 eligible identities therefore ties up $100,000, and provable equivocation burns the offending identities’ bonds.
